application: report per adjacent comparison and complete architecture. No numerical success cutoff or posthoc gate; qualitative status must cite predeclared dimensions and contrary evidence. No model switch or feature change follows automatically. Inner logloss alone selects C; classifications never select features. Status labels concern eventual run only and are NOT assigned in this contract task.
coefficient_interpretation: conditional additive association only; multicollinearity noted; no causal, hazard or round transition interpretation
frozen_policy: new architecture, thresholds, features, priors or model family require a new preregistration/version before training; never silently edit V1
leakage_boundary: prior fight outcomes are permitted historical F02 state; current/future labels, terrain/archetype IDs, audit historical rates and scoring outcomes cannot enter predictors or preprocessing
priority: S2 vs S1 addresses fighter-state value for complete system; S3 vs S2 broader additions; never declare complete-system success from conditional results alone

statuses.CLEAR_SUCCESS: joint directional evidence from aggregate loss, annual persistence, both paired intervals, calibration and composed performance supports added surface; quantify uncertainty and strongest-year dependence, not automatic promotion
statuses.CURRENT_SPECIFICATION_NOT_SUPPORTED: consistent failure to improve conditional and composed probability quality or coherent deterioration; rejects current specification, not all future method models
statuses.INCONCLUSIVE: mixed annual/conditional/composed evidence, intervals overlapping zero, sparse support, or calibration tradeoffs; explicitly enumerate discordance
